# Components & assets

<div class="gen-note">Generated from the APS 3.0 source code: every name, pin, default and description below is read from the plugin itself, so it matches what you see in the editor.</div>

Every APS component you can add to an actor, every asset type you can create, and every sense, with all their settings. All components are listed under **Add** in the Components panel: type `aps`.

## Components
### APS Core
<div class="comp-doc">The component that makes an AI perceive. Put it on the AI's <b>Pawn</b> (never its controller), assign a Perception Profile, and handle its events. <a href="../getting-started.html">Getting started</a></div>
It has [109 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-core) and [26 events](events.md#aps-core).

### APS Perception Listener
<div class="comp-doc">Optional. Make a Blueprint from it, implement the APS events there, and add it to every AI that should share those reactions. It must sit on the same actor as the APS Core.</div>
It has [20 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-perception-listener).

*No settings of its own: add it and it works.*

### APS Target Component
<div class="comp-doc">Optional, on anything AI look at (the player, NPCs, vehicles): where its sample points are, its stance, a light level from your own light gem, camouflage, and registration for non-Pawns. <a href="../features/confidence.html">Confidence</a></div>
It has [1 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-target-component).

### APS Observer
<div class="comp-doc">On an AI beside its APS Core: reports what it perceives to its faction, as a description, and discovers evidence. <a href="../features/knowledge.html#the-observer-a-guard-that-reports">Knowledge &amp; witnesses</a></div>
It has [6 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-observer).

<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="c-aps-observer-faction" data-search="Faction" data-text="Who this AI reports to. ### APS Evidence
<div class="comp-doc">Turns its actor into something AI can find and draw a conclusion from: a body, a forced lock, blood. <a href="../features/search.html#evidence">Search &amp; evidence</a></div>
It has [2 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-evidence).

<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="c-aps-evidence-evidence-tag" data-search="Evidence Tag" data-text="What kind of trace this is — &quot;Body&quot;, &quot;Blood&quot;, &quot;ForcedLock&quot;, &quot;Footprints&quot;. Blood dries; a body does not tidy itself away."><div class="set-head"><b>Lifetime Seconds</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>at least 0</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds before this fades from the world on its own. 0 = it stays until something removes it. Blood dries; a body does not tidy itself away.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-evidence-instigator" data-search="Instigator" data-text="Who caused it, if the game knows. Carried into the finder&#x27;s memory, so &quot;this was them&quot; is available without the AI having witnessed anything."><div class="set-head"><b>Instigator</b><span class="pin object"><i></i><small>Actor</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Who caused it, if the game knows. Carried into the finder&#x27;s memory, so &quot;this was them&quot; is available without the AI having witnessed anything.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-evidence-implied-direction" data-search="Implied Direction" data-text="Which way it suggests they went. Zero when it says nothing about direction."><div class="set-head"><b>Implied Direction</b><span class="pin vector"><i></i><small>Vector</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>(0, 0, 0)</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Which way it suggests they went. Zero when it says nothing about direction.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-evidence-auto-register-as-perceivable" data-search="Auto Register as Perceivable" data-text="Register this actor as perceivable on BeginPlay, so AI can find it with no further setup. Turn off if your project registers it another way."><div class="set-head"><b>Auto Register as Perceivable</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Register this actor as perceivable on BeginPlay, so AI can find it with no further setup. Turn off if your project registers it another way.</p></div></div></div>

### APS Search
<div class="comp-doc">Hands an AI the best place to look next while it searches, spreading at the target's speed and staying on the navmesh. <a href="../features/search.html#search">Search &amp; evidence</a></div>
It has [9 Blueprint nodes](nodes.md#aps-search).

<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="c-aps-search-cell-size" data-search="Cell Size" data-text="Grid resolution in cm. Smaller is more precise and costs more cells."><div class="set-head"><b>Cell Size</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>300</b></span><span>at least 50</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Grid resolution in cm. Smaller is more precise and costs more cells.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-search-grid-radius" data-search="Grid Radius" data-text="Half-width of the grid in cells. 20 at 300 cm covers a 120 m square."><div class="set-head"><b>Grid Radius</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>20</b></span><span>3 to 64</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Half-width of the grid in cells. 20 at 300 cm covers a 120 m square.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-search-target-speed" data-search="Target Speed" data-text="How fast the target is assumed able to move, cm/s. This is what turns elapsed time into a search area — set it near your player&#x27;s sprint speed."><div class="set-head"><b>Target Speed</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>450</b></span><span>at least 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How fast the target is assumed able to move, cm/s. This is what turns elapsed time into a search area — set it near your player&#x27;s sprint speed.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-search-clear-radius" data-search="Clear Radius" data-text="How close the searcher must get before a cell counts as checked (cm)."><div class="set-head"><b>Clear Radius</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>450</b></span><span>at least 50</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How close the searcher must get before a cell counts as checked (cm).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="c-aps-search-require-navigable" data-search="Require Navigable" data-text="Reject cells that are not on the navmesh, and hand out only places the searcher can walk to. This is what stops the search spreading through walls. Each point is the cell&#x27;s spot on the navmesh, never its raw centre (which can be inside a wall), and the first time a point comes up APS checks the sear"><div class="set-head"><b>Require Navigable</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Reject cells that are not on the navmesh, and hand out only places the searcher can walk to.</p><p>This is what stops the search spreading through walls. Each point is the cell&#x27;s spot on the navmesh, never its raw centre (which can be inside a wall), and the first time a point comes up APS checks the searcher has a full path to it: a closed room or a roof is skipped. Turned off — or with no navigation system present — every cell is accepted, which degrades to a plain expanding area rather than failing outright: a project with no navmesh should still get a usable search, not an empty one.</p></div></div></div>

## Assets
Create these in the Content Browser: right-click, **Miscellaneous → Data Asset**, and pick the class.

### Perception Profile
<div class="comp-doc">Every setting for how one kind of AI perceives. <a href="../guides/profiles.html">Profiles</a></div>
Its 174 settings have [their own page](profile.md).

### APS Quality Profile
<div class="comp-doc">Makes an AI cheaper or dearer without changing what it does: update rates, sample points, the light trace. Nothing it believes is reset. <a href="../guides/performance.html#2-quality-profiles">Performance &amp; crowds</a></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="a-aps-quality-profile-update-interval-scale" data-search="Update Interval Scale" data-text="Multiplier on the profile&#x27;s Base Update Interval. Above 1 means the whole perception pass runs less often; below 1 makes it more responsive."><div class="set-head"><b>Update Interval Scale</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span>0.1 to 20</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Multiplier on the profile&#x27;s Base Update Interval. Above 1 means the whole perception pass runs less often; below 1 makes it more responsive.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="a-aps-quality-profile-sense-interval-scale" data-search="Sense Interval Scale" data-text="Multiplies every sense&#x27;s update interval: thin out vision without slowing the rest."><div class="set-head"><b>Sense Interval Scale</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span>0.1 to 20</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Multiplies every sense&#x27;s update interval: thin out vision without slowing the rest.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="a-aps-quality-profile-max-vision-samples" data-search="Max Vision Samples" data-text="Hard cap on vision sample points per target, which is the single biggest trace cost in the system. 0 leaves the profile&#x27;s Vision Sample Count alone. This only ever lowers the count — a quality asset cannot make an agent more expensive than its profile asked for."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Vision Samples</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>0 to 16</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Hard cap on vision sample points per target, which is the single biggest trace cost in the system. 0 leaves the profile&#x27;s Vision Sample Count alone.</p><p>This only ever lowers the count — a quality asset cannot make an agent more expensive than its profile asked for.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="a-aps-quality-profile-skip-per-target-light" data-search="Skip Per Target Light" data-text="Skip the per-target light and sun-shadow trace and use the world&#x27;s light. This changes stealth: a target in shadow reads as lit. Only for AI nobody watches closely."><div class="set-head"><b>Skip Per Target Light</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Skip the per-target light and sun-shadow trace and use the world&#x27;s light. This changes stealth: a target in shadow reads as lit. Only for AI nobody watches closely.</p></div></div></div>

## Senses
A profile lists the senses its AI has in **Sense Classes**. Settings shared by every sense live on the profile; the settings below belong to one sense: to change them, make a Blueprint child of the sense (right-click it in the class picker, or **Blueprint Class** and search its name), set them in its Class Defaults, and put your child class in the profile's Sense Classes instead.

### Every sense
<div class="comp-doc">The parent of every sense, and of your own: a sense made directly from it sets these in its Class Defaults. The built-in senses ignore them. <a href="../guides/custom-senses.html">Custom senses</a></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="x-sense-default-interval" data-search="Default Interval" data-text="Seconds between evaluations of this sense. Overridden per-profile by Sense Intervals."><div class="set-head"><b>Default Interval</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.1</b></span><span>0 to 10</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds between evaluations of this sense. Overridden per-profile by Sense Intervals.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-sense-max-sensing-range" data-search="Max Sensing Range" data-text="Furthest this sense can reach (cm). Feeds the candidate-gathering radius, so a sense that reaches further than vision must say so or its targets are never even considered. 0 means it adds nothing to the gather range."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Sensing Range</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>at least 0</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Furthest this sense can reach (cm). Feeds the candidate-gathering radius, so a sense that reaches further than vision must say so or its targets are never even considered. 0 means it adds nothing to the gather range.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-sense-loss-grace-time" data-search="Loss Grace Time" data-text="Seconds after this sense stops reporting before the target can be lost."><div class="set-head"><b>Loss Grace Time</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.3</b></span><span>0 to 60</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds after this sense stops reporting before the target can be lost.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-sense-allows-direct-lost-cut" data-search="Allows Direct Lost Cut" data-text="True = jump straight to Lost once grace expires, the way vision does when a target steps behind a wall. False = fade down through the states."><div class="set-head"><b>Allows Direct Lost Cut</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>True = jump straight to Lost once grace expires, the way vision does when a target steps behind a wall. False = fade down through the states.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-sense-sense-loss-reason" data-search="Sense Loss Reason" data-text="Reason written to the belief record when this sense is the one that lost the target. Behaviour trees read it to decide how to search."><div class="set-head"><b>Sense Loss Reason</b><span class="pin enum"><i></i><small>Loss Reason</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>SensorDropout</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Reason written to the belief record when this sense is the one that lost the target. Behaviour trees read it to decide how to search.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-sense-subscribed-stimulus-tags" data-search="Subscribed Stimulus Tags" data-text="Stimulus tag prefixes this sense subscribes to. Prefix matched, so &quot;Stimulus.Sound&quot; receives &quot;Stimulus.Sound.Gunshot&quot;. Empty = opt out."><div class="set-head"><b>Subscribed Stimulus Tags</b><span class="pin name container"><i></i><small>Array of Name</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Stimulus tag prefixes this sense subscribes to. Prefix matched, so &quot;Stimulus.Sound&quot; receives &quot;Stimulus.Sound.Gunshot&quot;. Empty = opt out.</p></div></div></div>

### Damage Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Being hurt tells the AI who did it, at any range, from every Unreal damage call. <a href="../features/emotions.html#damage-knowing-who-hurt-it">Emotions &amp; pain</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*

### Echolocation Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Sonar pulses: no light or line of sight needed, precise up close. <a href="../features/senses.html#echolocation">Senses</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*

### Hearing Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Hears only the sounds your game emits, muffled by walls, building up with repeats. <a href="../features/hearing.html">Hearing</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*

### Pain Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Pain you report, and low health, dull the AI's other senses. <a href="../features/emotions.html#pain-senses-that-stop-working">Emotions &amp; pain</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*

### Smell Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Scent carried by the wind, in the dark and around corners; places a target only roughly. <a href="../features/senses.html#smell">Senses</a></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-max-smell-range" data-search="Max Smell Range" data-text="Maximum range at which this sense can detect targets (cm). Much shorter than vision or hearing; smell is close-range."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Smell Range</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>400</b></span><span>50 to 5000</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Maximum range at which this sense can detect targets (cm). Much shorter than vision or hearing; smell is close-range.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-wind-direction" data-search="Wind Direction" data-text="This sense&#x27;s own wind: the way the air moves (1, 0, 0 carries scent toward +X). (0, 0, 0) uses the world&#x27;s wind (Set Wind State, or an APS Environment)."><div class="set-head"><b>Wind Direction</b><span class="pin vector"><i></i><small>Vector</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>(0, 0, 0)</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>This sense&#x27;s own wind: the way the air moves (1, 0, 0 carries scent toward +X). (0, 0, 0) uses the world&#x27;s wind (Set Wind State, or an APS Environment).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-downwind-bonus" data-search="Downwind Bonus" data-text="How much stronger the scent is when the wind carries it straight to the AI: 2 is twice as strong."><div class="set-head"><b>Downwind Bonus</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>2</b></span><span>1 to 3</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How much stronger the scent is when the wind carries it straight to the AI: 2 is twice as strong.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-base-scent-intensity" data-search="Base Scent Intensity" data-text="Base scent intensity of targets. Increase for &quot;strongly scented&quot; targets (animals, sewage, explosives) or reduce for neutral/masked targets. This is the noise equivalent for smell: higher = easier to detect."><div class="set-head"><b>Base Scent Intensity</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span>0.01 to 5</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Base scent intensity of targets. Increase for &quot;strongly scented&quot; targets (animals, sewage, explosives) or reduce for neutral/masked targets. This is the noise equivalent for smell: higher = easier to detect.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-scent-threshold" data-search="Scent Threshold" data-text="Divides the scent intensity: lower is more sensitive."><div class="set-head"><b>Scent Threshold</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.4</b></span><span>0.01 to 2</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Divides the scent intensity: lower is more sensitive.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-wall-absorption-coeff" data-search="Wall Absorption Coeff" data-text="Absorption per wall crossing. Walls partially block scent (lower than hearing by default, since scent can seep under doors)."><div class="set-head"><b>Wall Absorption Coeff</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.25</b></span><span>0 to 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Absorption per wall crossing. Walls partially block scent (lower than hearing by default, since scent can seep under doors).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-smell-accumulation-rate" data-search="Smell Accumulation Rate" data-text="How fast scent confidence builds per second when target is in range."><div class="set-head"><b>Smell Accumulation Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.1</b></span><span>0.01 to 2</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How fast scent confidence builds per second when target is in range.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-smell-sense-smell-accumulation-decay-rate" data-search="Smell Accumulation Decay Rate" data-text="How fast scent confidence decays per second when target leaves range."><div class="set-head"><b>Smell Accumulation Decay Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.05</b></span><span>0.01 to 2</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How fast scent confidence decays per second when target leaves range.</p></div></div></div>

### Touch Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Contact: bumps, grabs, hits and blasts, wired automatically; the only sense that knows exactly where you are. <a href="../features/senses.html#touch">Senses</a></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="x-touch-sense-max-impulse-for-full-strength" data-search="Max Impulse for Full Strength" data-text="Impulse magnitude that maps to Strength=1.0. Scale to your game&#x27;s physics units."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Impulse for Full Strength</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1000</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p class="inert-why"><b>Does nothing in APS 3.0.</b> Overwritten every tick by the profile&#x27;s Touch Max Impulse for Full Strength, unless that is 0.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-touch-sense-contact-type-strength-multiplier" data-search="Contact Type Strength Multiplier" data-text="Confidence multiplier per contact type. Lets you tune impact per type in the asset."><div class="set-head"><b>Contact Type Strength Multiplier</b><span class="pin float container"><i></i><small>Map of Contact Type to Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Confidence multiplier per contact type. Lets you tune impact per type in the asset.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-touch-sense-persistent-accumulation-rate" data-search="Persistent Accumulation Rate" data-text="How fast persistent contact confidence builds per second. Grab held for 2s at AccumulationRate=0.3 → 0.6 accumulated confidence bonus."><div class="set-head"><b>Persistent Accumulation Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.3</b></span><span>at least 0</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p class="inert-why"><b>Does nothing in APS 3.0.</b> Overwritten every tick by the profile&#x27;s Touch Persistent Accumulation Rate, unless that is 0.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="x-touch-sense-max-persistent-bonus" data-search="Max Persistent Bonus" data-text="Max accumulated confidence bonus from persistent contact."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Persistent Bonus</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.5</b></span><span>0 to 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p class="inert-why"><b>Does nothing in APS 3.0.</b> Not used: the profile&#x27;s Touch Max Persistent Bonus always sets the cap.</p></div></div></div>

### Vibration Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Footsteps through the floor, through walls, faster movement felt more. <a href="../features/senses.html#vibration">Senses</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*

### Vision Sense
<div class="comp-doc">Sight: five points per target, cones, the head's direction, light, cover and see-through surfaces. <a href="../features/senses.html#vision">Senses</a></div>
*All of this sense's settings are on the Perception Profile.*
